query: I just took over a Next.js + Express monorepo from a contractor who left — there's frontend/ and backend/ dirs, no tests, no CI, husky's missing, commits are like 'stuff' and 'fixed it again'. Can you audit what we're missing before we can ship to an enterprise customer next quarter?

set up commitlint and husky on this monorepo — lint-staged running eslint on the backend and biome on the frontend packages/ui dir, and semantic-release so dev/staging/main produce alpha/rc/release versions. The repo has 4 months of git history on main so don't blow away existing CHANGELOG entries.

wire GitHub Actions to build my Docker image and push it to ghcr.io on every push to dev/staging/main, plus a Trivy scan with SARIF upload to the security tab, and Renovate for automated dep PRs on weekends

our ci.yml at .github/workflows/ci.yml already has three jobs named ci/backend, ci/ui, and commitlint — lock down branch protection on dev, staging, and main so nobody can push directly or force-push. Require one approval on dev/staging and two on main with linear history. Use gh to actually set it up against our remote

before we ship to prod I want a structured report of what's ready and what's not — sitemap, design tokens, storybook, SEO meta, lighthouse budgets, OpenAPI, pino logging, vitest, playwright, MSW, k6 load tests, the 3-branch model, commitlint, husky, gitleaks, semantic-release, trivy, renovate, makefile, docker-compose, LICENSE, SECURITY.md, CODEOWNERS, .env.example, .editorconfig, .nvmrc, and branch protection

the contractor left no LICENSE, SECURITY.md, or CODEOWNERS — add MIT license, a security policy saying report vulns to security@example.com not GitHub issues, and a CODEOWNERS requiring the platform team on .github/ and .husky/. Also commit a .env.example with every key the backend reads from process.env but values blanked
I want to add a dark mode toggle to my React component. It should use a context provider and respect prefers-color-scheme on first load
write a unit test for my `sum(a, b)` function using vitest — it should return the addition of two numbers and throw on non-number inputs
help me set up a new React Native project with Expo and configure the bundle, navigation, and a simple login screen with form validation
our database is slow — the users table query takes 4 seconds. Can you add an index on the email column and explain what EXPLAIN ANALYZE shows before and after?
deploy this Vercel app to production — run `vercel --prod` and give me the URL once it's live
set up a pull request template in .github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md that asks the contributor to describe the change, the test plan, and screenshot if UI
convert this CSV file at ~/Downloads/Q4-sales.csv into a polished xlsx with a chart showing revenue trend by month — the boss wants it formatted with our brand colors
create an Obsidian note for today's standup called 'standup-2026-08-02' with sections for blockers, in-progress, and done — link it to the project index
given this OpenAPI spec can you generate a TypeScript client SDK with zod schemas and fetch-based requests — put it in packages/api-client/
audit my repo's accessibility — run axe on the deployed site and give me a report of WCAG violations sorted by severity
I want to write a skill that helps me triage GitHub issues — interview me about the workflow then draft a SKILL.md with the right triggering description
set up lint-staged on this repo running eslint --fix on *.js files and prettier --write on *.json — just lint-staged, nothing else
review my PR for standards compliance — does the code follow this repo's documented coding standards and does it match what the originating issue asked for?
our Playwright test flake rate is 30% — diagnose which selectors are racy and propose replacements using getByRole instead of getByText
